answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The echo edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 61 clones produces a signature the signal analysis flags immediately. An adversary must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the cipher settlement applies the void retroactively. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
